target: Char Residue = cone residue (final/initial specimen mass, %), FSRI; canonical per plan §3 B3
declared: by Opus 5.5, see git commit time; before any run

incumbent.config: data/v2/train_char_residue_v2.py cone benchmark: RF(n_estimators=300, max_depth=6, min_samples_leaf=2) on heat_flux_kWm2, density_kgm3, mcc_char_yield_pct, sta_res_3K, sta_res_10K, sta_res_30K

data: exactly exp033's rows (must reproduce 0.538 [0.112, 0.713] first, else status blocked)

candidates.desc: incumbent features + inorganic-fraction proxy: STA residue in AIR (material mean) if the FSRI STA data has air runs, else a category flag (mineral/inorganic-containing category one-hot); RF incumbent settings
c1 features, HistGradientBoostingRegressor(learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=10, random_state=0)
best of c1/c2 by GKF mean, with logit transform of residue fraction (clip to [0.005, 0.995]), predictions back-transformed to %

diagnostic: per-category error table (category, n materials, mean |error|, share of squared error) for incumbent and selected candidate; written to the run log. Not a selection input.
selection_rule: highest repeated-GKF mean; promote only if >= 8/10 paired wins vs exp033 AND ci_lo >= 0.112
banned: STA N2 residue as the target; MCC char yield as a feature for an STA target
